Final archive retention limit: 14 snapshots. Keep the newest completed snapshots only.

# Package receipts

Package receipts bind an artifact digest to its signer. The recipient checks the original digest before accepting the artifact.

# Artifact signer

The artifact signer consumes [[Projects/example/entities/package-receipts|package receipts]] and returns detached signatures.
A rotation failure is described in [[Projects/example/records/problems/signing-failure|the signing incident]].

# Signing incident

Signing incident recovery waits for a second approval before rotating the key reference.
The affected [[Projects/example/entities/artifact-signer|artifact signer]] refuses new releases while approval is pending.

# Runner drain

Runner drain preserves the last completed build and pauses new scheduling.

# Receipt archive

Receipt archive imports detached receipts without rewriting the original bytes.

# Similar plural identity

This compatibility listing is a spelling distractor; it does not define the receipt archive.

# Accepted manifest

Release manifest records the accepted compiler flags and artifact digest.
